result.title: Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach
result.comment: 14 pages plus 2 pages of references, 1 figure
result.summary: Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种借鉴 GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS 等模块化方法的 LLM 架构改造方案，把危险能力分区隔离，使其调用（尤其是与危险推理类型组合时）能以比 chain of thought 更廉价、更持久的方式被监测，并讨论能力移除等附带收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其按模块划分内部状态并据此低成本监测与定位能力来源的思路，可能可供核查能否用于 latent 推理状态的贡献归因与何时告警/停止的判断。
